subject: Adjustment to the parcel delivery
text:
Hello,

The courier service just asked me to narrow the delivery window because their route changed. They can still bring the box, but it will likely arrive earlier than we first discussed. They said the new window is before noon instead of in the afternoon.

I can keep the key at my desk if you will be out, and I can hold it until you return. If that is inconvenient, we could ask them to leave it in the building office, though I would need a moment to confirm their rules.

I am happy to help however is simplest. I hope this is manageable.
